Shape Precheck

Shape precheck using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

shape_precheck(text, facts)

Example input

{
  "text": "Lint passed. Integration failed.",
  "facts": [
    "lint",
    "integration"
  ]
}

Example output

{
  "checks": {
    "first_line_present": true,
    "no_preamble": true,
    "required_facts_present": true,
    "no_generic_closer": true
  },
  "passed": 4,
  "total": 4,
  "missing": [],
  "scope": "shape-only; refusal correctness and factual accuracy unverified"
}

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py shape_precheck < examples/shape-precheck.json

Limits

Shape only: never a quality score or release verdict.
